title: Til Ex Do Us Part
description: A woman is accused of arranging an attack on a woman who slept with her boyfriend during a break.

title: Running Away
description: A woman must come to terms with the dark secrets that made her daughter run away from home.

title: Ring of Deception
description: A single mother's life is turned upside down when a con man moves to her neighbourhood. While she falls for him, a second woman is determined to kill him, and doesn't care who gets in her way.

title: Amish Abduction
description: Amish wife and mother Annie faces a crisis when her husband leaves the word of the Amish to live among normal Americans, or the English as the Amish dub them. But things turn even more dire when her husband returns, seeking custody of their son, and is willing to kill to achieve his goal.

title: The Wrong Husband
description: After going away on business, a woman returns to find that her husband's behaviour has changed, and she can't help but worry that all is not what it seems.

title: Her Boyfriend's Secret
description: After believing she has found the guy of her dreams, home renovator Melissa Davis soon learns that her dream man has a dark secret.

title: Watching Over You
description: A single mum moves into the suburbs and starts dating a firefighter, only to find herself the target of an obsessive neighbourhood watchman who aims to prove he's the best man to protect her -- even if he has to create the danger himself.

title: A Romance Wedding
description: Helping out at the family café in her hometown, wedding planner Zoe is reunited with aspiring chef Will, her old sweetheart.

title: A Man for Every Month
description: To get a feature out for her company's Man for Every Month blog, an introverted writer has to go on a date with a different man every month.

title: An Hour Behind
description: A case of mistaken identity and the time change come together to create a magical blind date for two people.

description:
